title: Normalization of the constant set comparison on constant sections
statement: Let (C,JC),(D,JD) be small sites, and L a functor between their set-sheaf categories. Suppose κ:constant_C ⋙ L ≅ constant_D is natural in all sets as in [lem-route-inverse-image-constant-set-comparison]. Assume commutative-ring sheafification exists. Conjugate κ by the canonical underlying-set comparisons to a natural comparison on constant ring sheaves. For a commutative ring A, a∈A, a set sheaf T, and s:T→|constant_C A| whose every section has value the sheafification unit of a, the composite L(s) followed by this conjugated comparison has every section equal to the target sheafification unit of a. No finite-limit or adjointness assumption on L is needed once κ is given.

proof.text: The constant singleton sheaf is terminal, so its sections over every object are unique. This uses preservation of limits by sheafification, the inclusion into presheaves, and evaluation.

source.place: Tag 0H7J (Example example-constant-sheaf) and Tag 00YV (proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi): constant sheaves and inverse image of algebraic structures

proof.text: Let i_a be the constant map from the singleton to the underlying set A. Naturality of the sheafification unit and sheafComposeIso_hom_fac show that its induced map into the constant ring sheaf sends the unit section to the ring-valued constant section a. The given s is the unique map to the singleton sheaf followed by this map, by equality on every section.

source.place: Tag 0H7J (Example example-constant-sheaf) and Tag 00YV (proposition-functoriality-algebraic-structures-topoi): constant sheaves and inverse image of algebraic structures

proof.text: Apply L to that factorization, cancel the source underlying-set comparison against its inverse, and use naturality of κ for the function i_a. The remaining source of i_a is the target singleton sheaf, whose sections are unique. Naturality of the sheafification unit and the target underlying-set comparison now give precisely the asserted target constant section.

lean.statement: theorem canonicalConstantSectionComparison {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D] (JC : GrothendieckTopology C) (JD : GrothendieckTopology D) [HasWeakSheafify JC CommRingCat.{u}] [HasWeakSheafify JD CommRingCat.{u}] (L : Sheaf JC (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type u)) (kappa : constantSheaf JC (Type u) ⋙ L ≅ constantSheaf JD (Type u)) : ∀ (a : CommRingCat.{u}) (x : a) (T : Sheaf JC (Type u)) (s : T ⟶ (sheafCompose JC (forget CommRingCat)).obj ((constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}).obj a)), (∀ (U : Cᵒᵖ) (y : T.obj.obj U), (@id (((constantSheaf JC CommRingCat.{u}).obj a).obj.obj U) (s.hom.app U y)) = (toSheafify JC ((Functor.const Cᵒᵖ).obj a)).app U x) → ∀ (W : Dᵒᵖ) (z : (L.obj T).obj.obj W), (@id (((constantSheaf JD CommRingCat.{u}).obj a).obj.obj W) ((constantRingSetComparison JC JD L kappa).hom.app a |>.hom.app W ((L.map s).hom.app W z))) = (toSheafify JD ((Functor.const Dᵒᵖ).obj a)).app W x
